Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Here is how our two most popular cold plunge models compare:
• The Plunge (Original): Our iconic, best-value model featuring the plunge tub paired with an external Pro Chiller Gen 2. It offers powerful, reliable cooling and is ideal if you want a classic, proven setup with excellent value for everyday use.
• All-In Gen 2: Our top-selling, most advanced model. It features a seamless, plug-and-plunge design with the chiller built right into the unit, plus smart app controls and simplified filter access for effortless setup and maintenance.
If value for money and a classic daily setup are your top priorities, The Plunge is a fantastic fit. If you prefer a streamlined design with everything integrated into one sleek unit for maximum convenience, the All-In Gen 2 is the way to go.
